title: CSCI 541 — Programming Skills
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a programming language reference and explain how they map to program execution.
Explain how intermediate representations (IR) and source code relate to compiler phases and verification.
Apply debugging and decomposition strategies to isolate syntax, runtime, and logical failures in code.
